paragraphs: Rav Chinena bar Rav Yitzchak and R. Shmuel bar Immi: Jerusalem Talmud, Keitzad Mevarkhin, mishnah 1. R. Chanina son of R. Yitzchak: Shocher Tov, sections 6, 100, and Esther Midrash, on “The drinking was according to the law.” R. Huna said in his name; see Yehoshua above. Chanina bar Yitzchak: R. Yehoshua bar Nechemyah, in his name—Bereshit Rabbah, beginning of section 14. Yuchasin lists Rav Chanan bar Yitzchak, Shmuel's student, and also Chanina bar Yitzchak; apparently they are all one.
